protocol.endpoint_visibility: Task endpoints visible to all rankers; test outcomes withheld. Transductive task-conditioned selection.
leakage_controls: Disjoint graph seeds and context hashes
No held-out goal endpoint pair is offered as a candidate
All methods receive identical candidates and budgets
Model labels use training-context search outcomes only
All candidates must traverse the verified seed; primitive graph contains no candidate declarations
protocol.budget_accounting: Equal selected theorem count and per-goal BFS expansion cap. Primitive proof-edge counts and search expansions reported separately. Model training and candidate enumeration are offline/common costs; no equal wall-time claim.
protocol.verification: Search witnesses only until independently certified by Lean. No search timeout implies mathematical necessity.

limitations: Procedural propositional implication graphs, not natural mathematical research or Mathlib.
No claim that selected consequences are mathematically novel.
A bounded BFS advantage is search compression, not mathematical necessity.
All test contexts come from the same generator family; domain transfer is unmeasured.
Semantic baseline is transparent lexical cosine, not a pretrained theorem embedding model.
Ensemble disagreement is not calibrated epistemic uncertainty.
No GPU, LLM generation, or graph neural network is used.
Labels are synthetic invariant names; they carry little genuine mathematical semantics.

formal_verification.scope: All candidate proofs and all distinct successful baseline/augmented test witnesses across every policy and random repetition. Failed searches produce no theorem.
